## My Visualization

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = category))

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#count number of observations each year for hurricanes with wind above the 75th percentile for observations/hurricanes IN THAT YEAR. 

storms |> 
  filter(status == "hurricanes") |>
  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(threshold = quantile(wind, probs = 0.75)) |> 
  ungroup() |> #always good to do 
  filter(wind > threshold) |>
  count(year)
#output seems to be not working for this??

```
